answer: Before the light fails the warp maker dyes the yarn in the madder vat till it turns a deep red, stirring the vat till the colour takes hold. Distaff indigo fleece picker mordant patent rules the dyeing: a patent indigo fleece pickers file after picking table audits. The falcon opens the dyeing, the ferrous watches the vat, the garden shuts the yarn. A cheat would need 67 false vats and 67 false dyeings.
